fired.warning: At FY2026 results, estimated locally for **5 November**, re-read by **10 November 2026** if physical volumes decline again, if free cash flow is **70% or less of company-adjusted net income**, or if trailing operating profit divided by average total assets falls below **13%**. Any one warns. The cash threshold is management's stated commitment; the asset-return threshold is my decision rule. Use the release's volume bridge when a percentage is not supplied; missing disclosure is unknown, not growth. [Q3 release](https://ir.muellerwaterproducts.com/press-releases/2026/08-05-2026-211118748).
fired.break: Sell the position under §5.1 if either of the first two post-entry quarters reports a GAAP operating margin below **16%**, or if **both** quarters have declining physical volumes and GAAP operating margins below **18%**. Independently, sell if trailing operating profit divided by average total assets falls below **11%** at either of those reports. Review the two-quarter test by **28 February 2027**. These thresholds are analyst choices: the separate margin and asset-return routes prevent rising prices from hiding falling capital productivity. For the asset test, use **filed TTM operating income after all operating charges / mean of total assets at the TTM beginning and end**. This is a pre-tax operating return on assets, not ROIC and not annualised single-quarter profit. Obtain the comparable filings at each review; if the beginning balance or a quarter is unavailable, report the test as unavailable and escalate the review rather than substituting local adjusted operating income. Today's nine-month filed operating income is $217.7m and June total assets $1,953.3m, but those are not a TTM ratio. [Q3 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1350593/000135059326000036/mwa-20260630.htm). These improve the proposed monitoring terms; the existing accepted proposal is not rewritten by an unaccepted top-up. If Leo accepts this proposal, use these tests for the resulting eight-share position.

fired.warning: At the FY2026 release, expected around 5 November (local date is an estimate), either another reported decline in consolidated physical volumes **or** FY free cash flow at or below 70% of management's adjusted net income triggers a re-read. The first tests whether price is masking demand; the second tests whether the profit is becoming cash. The 70% reference is management's cash-conversion commitment in its [Q3 release](https://ir.muellerwaterproducts.com/press-releases/2026/08-05-2026-211118748). If volumes are not quantified, use the explicit direction in the sales bridge; silence is unavailable evidence, not a pass.
fired.break: By the Q1 FY2027 release, reviewed no later than **28 February 2027**, two successive post-entry quarters with declining consolidated volumes **and** GAAP operating margin below **18% in each** break the capacity-return thesis and call for an exit under §5.1. This is my decision threshold, below the locally recorded FY2025 margin, not company guidance. Use filed operating income after reorganisation charges, not the local field if the discrepancy below persists. A missing disclosure triggers review, not an invented result.
